jobs.title: Front-End Engineer
description: Led and participated in the front-end development, maintenance, and performance optimization of core products, ensuring high system availability.
Collaborated with the team to define front-end technology roadmaps and project architecture standards, improving development consistency and scalability.
Participated in a full product line refactoring project, successfully increasing system stability by 50% and reducing long-term maintenance costs by 50%.
Collaborated with the design team to establish a cross-product UI Component Library, covering 80% of design needs and shortening the development cycle for new features by 50%.
Introduced Trunk Based Development workflow, significantly improving iteration flexibility and enabling Feature Toggles.
Migrated part of the company's products to a Monorepo architecture, effectively integrating shared modules and reducing cross-project maintenance costs.
Built a complete CI/CD automated deployment process, eliminating human error risks and improving deployment efficiency.
Established and implemented a Code Review mechanism to ensure code quality and promote technical exchange within the team.

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer
description: Responsible for front-end development and optimization of core products.
Utilized core-js and Babel to solve cross-browser compatibility issues, ensuring stable operation of the social platform in legacy environments.
Deeply investigated and resolved Nuxt.js SSR memory leak issues, eliminating service restart pain points and significantly improving system stability.
Implemented interactive stock K-line and trend charts using ECharts, providing a smooth data visualization experience.
Integrated LINE LIFF and LINE BOT investment assistants, creating a seamless interaction experience between the social platform and messaging software.
Collaborated on the development of LINE BOT investment assistant features to increase user engagement.
